hypothesis: Explicit low-byte replacement (packed & ~0xFF) | (step & 0xFF) prevents GC/1.3 from reversing the packed-color insertion and folding away the shift. Follow-up variants investigate operand typing, expression grouping and accumulator lifetimes under that mask.
measurement_basis: Scores, sizes and instruction differences below are derived from actual per-variant objdiff JSON. Per-variant temporary raw files were removed after extraction; final retained-source canonical and relocation-strict raw files are committed separately. Build and diff process output strings are verbatim. Six initial loads_* harness runs failed because the experiment delimiter also replaced a C OR operator; corrected reruns follow.
